layers.description: Stable administrative and context features exported as PMTiles snapshots.
Live baseline MVT tiles served by Martin from serving_geo.get_tile().
Reserved live tile source for scenario-sensitive overlays; stays dynamic in v1.

Live MVT choropleth from serving_geo.indicator_overlay_tile. Caller must set indicator_slug; scenario_id is optional. With delta set, the same function serves the scenario's difference from the baseline instead of its values.

query_params.feature_type: OPTIONAL — filter to one grain (block, ageb, …). Without it, every feature_type the indicator applies to is rendered, so multi-grain indicators stack polygons.
query_params.delta: OPTIONAL — boolean in Postgres's spelling, whitespace trimmed, case ignored: 1, t, tr, tru, true, y, ye, yes, on (not o — ambiguous). Emits delta + state (changed | unchanged | new) in place of value_numeric + quality_flag, matching GET /scenarios/{id}/comparison. Needs scenario_id: without one the tile is empty, because there is nothing to difference against. Draw it with a diverging ramp centred on zero, never the value ramp.
